name: BeBalanced Hormone Weight Loss Centers, Royersford
category: Natural hormone balancing and weight loss
hours: Mon and Thu 10 am to 6 pm. Fri 10 am to 4 pm. Sat by appointment.
description: BeBalanced Royersford uses natural hormone balancing to help women lose weight and improve mood, sleep, energy, and menopausal symptoms, from the center at 519 Main Street.
tagline: Natural hormone balancing and weight loss

hero.headline: Balance first. Weight follows.
hero.sub: BeBalanced Royersford works with your body to correct key hormone imbalances naturally, which BeBalanced reports leads to weight loss and better sleep and energy.

offerings.heading: What the program <mark>covers.</mark>
items: A natural hormone balancing program that works with the body
Support for PMS, perimenopause, and menopause symptoms
Weight loss BeBalanced reports at 15 to 21 pounds in 30 days on average
Mon and Thu 10 to 6, Fri 10 to 4

story.heading: Why balance comes first
paragraphs: BeBalanced's method starts with hormones, not calories, correcting the imbalances that keep weight on and sleep off.
The center says most clients see improvement in mood, sleep, energy, hot flashes, and bloating.

experience.heading: The first thirty days
items: A consultation on Main Street to review symptoms and goals.
A personalized program with coaching visits at the center.
Check-ins that track the scale and the symptoms.

feature.heading: Built for peri and menopause
feature.text: Designed for the years when the old diets stop working. Hormone balancing addresses the cause.
